title: Monsoon Cascade
description: 6-minute automated narrative demo scenario simulating severe monsoon cloudburst over Khasi hills, landslide road blockage on NH-6 corridor, autonomous 9-stage replan cascade, and officer approval gate.

beats.name: Cold Open
beats.description: Baseline calm morning at 06:00. All routes green, normal dispatch.

beats.name: Storm Advance
beats.description: Rainfall builds in Khasi hills. Heatmap hexes cascade orange as antecedent rain saturates slopes.

beats.name: Pre-Positioning Advice
beats.description: Pre-positioning advisor fires for Jowai sub-depot before time-to-isolation reaches zero.

beats.name: Landslide Blockage
beats.description: Control room confirms major landslide on NH-6 trunk segment #100001. 9-stage cascade fires.

beats.name: Autonomous Replan Proposed
beats.description: Cascade completes in < 2.5s. Proposed plan: 4 vehicles rerouted, 1 emergency protected, 2 deferred.

beats.name: Officer Approval Gate
beats.description: Officer reviews risk badges and approves dispatch. Field drivers receive change cards.

beats.name: Judge Counterfactual What-If
beats.description: Judge map-picks Shillong bypass to close. Counterfactual simulator returns diff in < 3s.
